exposure: temporary cessation in oxytocin infusion (oxytocin rest)
cohort: 1193 nulliparous women with term, vertex, singleton gestations undergoing induction of labor with continuous oxytocin infusion
finding: An oxytocin rest of at least 8 hours may reduce the risk of cesarean delivery among women with protracted latent labor without significantly increasing maternal or neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: An oxytocin rest of at least 8 hours was associated with a lower risk of cesarean delivery.
